newsitem.title: USA: Great Western sets additional repurchase.
newsitem.headline: Great Western sets additional repurchase.

text.p: Great Western Financial Corp on Tuesday said its board of directors authorized the repurchase of up to 5 million additional shares of its common stock during the next 12 months.
In July, the company authorized the repurchase of 7.5 million shares, of which about 6.8 million shares have already been purchased at an average price of $26.93 each, it said.
Great Western has about 139 million shares outstanding.

Great Western said that it would make the repurchases from time to time in the open market or through privately negotiated transactions. Repurchased shares will become treasury shares, to be used for capital management and general corporate purposes.
